description: Base Defence is a zombie strategy game where heroes are deployed to protect a base from relentless hordes. Drag troops into position, merge matching units into stronger defenders, upgrade the line, and survive escalating waves.
intro: The useful content centers on decisions visible in every run: where to place heroes, which troops to merge, when to keep multiple defenders, and how to respond when a new zombie wave reaches the base faster than expected.
guideTitle: Base Defence Hero Placement, Merge, and Wave Guide
guideIntro: A stronger unit is valuable only if the merge does not leave an important lane open. Build coverage first, then combine troops where the upgraded defender can handle the next wave.
steps: Drag heroes into positions that cover the paths zombies use to approach the base.
Keep enough active troops on the field before merging two defenders into one stronger unit.
Merge matching troops where the upgraded hero can attack the most dangerous part of the wave.
Reposition or reinforce the side that begins leaking zombies instead of upgrading a safe lane again.
Use each failed wave to identify whether the next investment should be coverage, troop strength, or placement.
